name: Compound faults
description: Two or more C-class faults in one file (e.g., C2+C9, C5+C10).
generator_spec: Apply k in {2,3} generators from C1-C10/DMG in random order; seed recorded per file.
realism: Real damage (disk, transfer) is rarely single-component (CLM-0006).

name: Mid-file block holes
description: One or more 512 B/4 KiB aligned blocks zeroed or replaced with foreign data (bad sectors, unallocated clusters).
generator_spec: Zero or overwrite N aligned blocks at uniform offsets; N and block size parameterised.
realism: Storage-level loss is sector/cluster granular; carving motivation (CLM-0023).

name: Head truncation / missing prefix
description: The first K bytes missing (carved from mid-file, partial recovery).
generator_spec: Drop the first K% (5-50%) of bytes.
realism: Carved and recovered fragments often lack the header region.

name: Object-stream corruption
description: Damage inside a compressed /ObjStm, losing many objects at once.
generator_spec: Flip/zero bytes within one ObjStm's compressed data or its /First offset table.
realism: PDF >=1.5 packs most objects in ObjStm; REPDF's C2 only removes a classic xref table.

name: Cross-reference stream damage
description: Damage to a /Type /XRef stream (not a classic table).
generator_spec: Truncate/flip bytes in the xref stream or its /W /Index fields.
realism: Modern producers emit xref streams; untested by REPDF.

name: Fragmented / interleaved file
description: File carved as out-of-order or interleaved fragments with foreign data between.
generator_spec: Split into F fragments, shuffle, interleave with foreign bytes; ground-truth order kept.
realism: Carving from disk/RAM yields fragmented data (REPDF motivation, untested).

name: Distributed bit rot
description: Random bit flips across many streams (aging media, transmission).
generator_spec: Flip B random bits over the file with density parameter.
realism: Aging media and transmission errors cause scattered or bursty bit errors across many streams. Note that REPDF's C9 already substitutes 12-30 bytes over 11-28 streams (OBS-0002); this class adds realistic error models (burst length, sector alignment, density) rather than more of the same.

name: Broken incremental update
description: A truncated or corrupted incremental-update section on top of an intact base revision.
generator_spec: Append an update, then truncate/corrupt within it.
realism: Incrementally-updated (edited/signed) PDFs are common; prior revisions are recoverable evidence.

name: Adversarial / anti-forensic manipulation
description: Deliberate structural manipulation meant to mislead viewers or repair tools: incremental-update shadowing, duplicate xref entries, object-number reuse, conflicting trailers, parser-differential constructs.
generator_spec: Apply documented attack templates (to be taken from literature found in P1) to known originals; label the intended hidden and visible content.
realism: Forensic reviewer FO-B1: validation must cover deliberate manipulation, not only accidents. Literature to be linked.

name: Transfer mangling
description: Binary damaged in transit: FTP ASCII-mode CRLF conversion, UTF-8 re-encoding that inserts EF BF BD, MIME/base64 wrapping errors.
generator_spec: Apply CRLF<->LF conversion, text re-encoding with replacement characters, or broken base64 line wrapping to the whole file.
realism: PDF internals reviewer: common real-world origin distinct from storage loss.

name: Producer bugs
description: Files malformed at creation: wrong /Length, xref offsets off by N, missing endobj, bad object streams.
generator_spec: Perturb /Length values, shift xref offsets by N bytes, drop endobj keywords; also harvest real examples from engine test corpora (P1 engine study).
realism: Likely the most common real damage; engines carry repair code for it.

name: Zero-filled tail
description: The file has its full length but the end is zeros (crash during write, preallocated download).
generator_spec: Overwrite the last K% of bytes with 0x00, keeping size.
realism: Crash-interrupted writes and preallocating download managers.

name: Junk prefix or suffix
description: Foreign bytes before %PDF- or after %%EOF (HTTP headers, email wrappers, appended data).
generator_spec: Prepend or append N bytes of HTTP/MIME/random data.
realism: Saved web responses and mail attachments.

name: Hybrid-reference and revision ambiguity
description: Files with classic xref plus /XRefStm, multiple incremental sections, or linearization, where carving without the xref selects the wrong object revision (possibly resurrecting redacted content).
generator_spec: Build multi-revision originals (edits, redactions, signatures), then remove xref/trailer sections.
realism: Every Save As file the PDF internals reviewer checked was hybrid-reference with 2 sections.

name: Encryption /ID loss
description: Encrypted file (R2-R4) whose trailer /ID is lost, so the key cannot be derived even with an empty user password.
generator_spec: Encrypt originals with an empty user password, then remove the trailer /ID (and optionally earlier trailers).
realism: Key derivation uses /ID; trailer damage (C3) on encrypted files makes them undecryptable.

name: Non-Flate filter damage
description: Damage to DCT (partial JPEG), JBIG2 with lost /JBIG2Globals, CCITT, LZW, or lost /DecodeParms predictors.
generator_spec: Flip/truncate bytes inside non-Flate streams; delete /JBIG2Globals or /DecodeParms entries.
realism: Scanned and image-heavy producers use these filters; REPDF only tests Flate.
